title: Amazon’s always-listening Bee wearable can now help you buy stuff
hook_text: Amazon just built an always-listening wearable.
script:
Amazon just launched the seventy-four ninety-nine Bee Frontier wearable.
It is an updated version of a fifty dollar startup device Amazon bought last year.
The device constantly listens to every conversation you have and summarizes it.
Now, the new Bee devices can also help you buy products.
Amazon is releasing two new devices along with a brand new subscription.
Would you wear an always-listening microphone?
